ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible surface with localized high-intensity (white) clusters at the distal tips and scattered points; estimated macro-ratio of approximately 18:1 black-to-white pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, contiguous low-intensity (black) region covering the entire visible ventral area. High-intensity (white) clusters are localized at the far left and far right distal tips. Numerous discrete high-intensity circular ring patterns are mapped across the central and outer regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with an acute interior angle; the vertex is deeply recessed toward the peduncle, creating a distinct separation between lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by irregular peaks and valleys ranging from 10 to 50 pixels in depth, clearly isolated from the water surface.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Continuous convex curves sweeping outward and upward from the median notch to the distal tips, terminating in sharp points encrusted with barnacles.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular high-intensity nodes (barnacles) at both distal extremities. Multiple isolated circular ring-like depigmentation marks (diameters of 10-25 pixels) are scattered across the black fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of several distinct, high-contrast linear pixel disruptions on the right lobe, including three parallel vertical marks and one longer diagonal scratch near the upper trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the distal tips; widespread circular ring-shaped scars and several white linear rake marks across the pigmented surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique distribution of multiple perfectly circular white ring-scars (likely lamprey or parasite attachment marks) providing high-contrast visual identifiers against the solid black background.
